title: Financial services
description: Adapt reviews to banks, insurers, payment and investment firms and the ICT providers that serve them.
context: Ask the compliance owner whether the organization is a financial entity under DORA (Regulation (EU) 2022/2554) and which competent authority supervises it. When it is, select the dora-financial-entity pattern.
Name the owners of ICT risk, incident reporting and ICT third-party contracts before changing a system that supports a critical or important function.
Record which payment, customer or market data the change touches and the retention rules that apply to it.
